rundown: Oilers beat Flyers 5-2 at Xfinity Mobile Arena in Philadelphia, PA in front of 18,903. Oilers led 3-2 after two periods and never looked back. The 1st period decided it: Oilers won it 3-0.
7 goals in all. Oilers's last: Connor McDavid Goal Wrist Shot, assists: Ryan Shea (5), Leon Draisaitl (21), 3rd period 18:52.
Leading the way — Oilers: Leon Draisaitl 2 goals, 3 pts; Connor McDavid 2 ast. Flyers: Noah Cates 1 goal, 1 pts; Cam York 1 ast.
Where Oilers won it: they scored 2 on the power play to 0.
Against the closing line (DraftKings): Oilers closed as 1.5-goal favorites and covered by 1.5; the total closed at 5.5 and they combined for 7, over by 1.5.

review.title: The algo's call
review.body:
Logged before the start, last snapshot Nov 15, 7:29 PM ET. It had Oilers 56% and Flyers 44%, projecting Oilers 3 – Flyers 2.7 (5.7 total, Oilers by 0.3).

Final: Oilers 5 – Flyers 2. Right winner: it had Oilers at 56%.

review.title: How the ratings held up
review.body:
Oilers came in with a 7% above average attack and a 3% stingier than average defense (15-3-3, 3.9 scored and 2.8 allowed a game over 21 games), worth about 79 and 78 games of evidence. Projected to score 3, they scored 5 (+2 goals, 65% over); projected to allow 2.7, they allowed 2 (−0.7 goals, 26% under).

Flyers came in with a 6% below average attack and a 3% stingier than average defense (6-10-6, 2.3 scored and 3.3 allowed a game over 22 games), worth about 79 and 80 games of evidence. Projected to score 2.7, they scored 2 (−0.7 goals, 26% under); projected to allow 3, they allowed 5 (+2 goals, 65% over).

The bigger miss was Oilers' scoring (+2 goals against projection).

review.title: Where the result sat in the simulations
review.body:
Total: 7 against 5.7 projected (+1.3), about the 70th percentile of the simulated totals (a typical game swings ±2.5).

Margin: Oilers by 3 against Oilers by 0.3 projected, about the 14th percentile of the simulated margins (typical swing ±2.5).

An unusual result, but one the simulations saw regularly (roughly one game in six to one in twenty).

review.title: Situational factors, checked
review.body: Nothing situational moved this projection (rest, travel, form and conditions were all normal), so it came down to team strength.

review.title: Against the market
review.body:
PHI ML (+120) at +120: the algo gave it 44% vs 44% fair (+0.1 pts) — lost (-1u); lost to the close (closing fair chance 45%). EDM ML (-142) at -142: the algo gave it 56% vs 56% fair (-0.1 pts) — won (+0.7u); lost to the close (closing fair chance 55%). PHI +1.5 (-218) at -218: the algo gave it 66% vs 66% fair (+0.5 pts) — lost (-1u); same number as the close. EDM -1.5 (+180) at +180: the algo gave it 34% vs 34% fair (-0.5 pts) — won (+1.8u); same number as the close. OVER 5.5 (-122) at -122: the algo gave it 52% vs 53% fair (-0.5 pts) — won (+0.8u); same number as the close. UNDER 5.5 (+102) at +102: the algo gave it 48% vs 47% fair (+0.5 pts) — lost (-1u); same number as the close.

The line barely moved between the algo's snapshot and the close.

No bet: nothing cleared the algo's bar before the game.

review.title: Where the public and the money were
review.body:
Splits (Action Network): spread: 66% of bets on Oilers, 88% of the money — Oilers covered; total: 84% of bets on the over, 91% of the money — it went over; moneyline: 93% of bets on Oilers, 97% of the money.

The sharp side by the algo's read was Oilers, who won and covered.

review.title: What the algo learns
review.body:
This game's own lesson: scoring came in at ×1.137 of the raw projection, and the home side beat its projected margin by -2.9 goals. It counts toward NHL scoring level, home edge and both teams' attack and defense corrections.

Across 81 graded NHL games the algo now scales scoring ×0.942 and gives home teams -0.3 goals. Team corrections so far: Oilers attack ×0.985, defense ×0.960 (6 games); Flyers attack ×1.001, defense ×1.009 (6 games).

review.title: Bottom line
review.body: Right side, total within its normal range, margin outside its normal range (off by 2.7 goals), no bet.
